gdpr.title: Permanent Delete (GDPR)
gdpr.desc1: Unlike a regular delete (recoverable), this option immediately destroys your encryption keys (Crypto Shredding). Once destroyed, the ciphertext remaining in the database can never be decrypted.
gdpr.desc2: If you just want to leave your account, use "Delete Account" in Settings. That path offers a 90-day recovery window.
gdpr.label: Type confirmation phrase
gdpr.finalDesc: Your encryption keys will be permanently destroyed. No data recovery will be possible afterwards. Continue?
gdpr.successMsg: Your encryption keys and account data have been destroyed.

restore.title: Restore Account
restore.desc1: Your account is currently soft-deleted. You can recover it within 90 days of the deletion request.
restore.desc2: After 90 days it moves to cold archive (additional 275 days), recoverable only via admin support. After a total of 1 year it is permanently deleted.
restore.desc3: Your encryption keys (DEKs) are preserved by default. For permanent destruction, use "GDPR Delete".
restore.failMsg: The recovery window (90 days) has expired or the state has changed.

signup.termsBiometricFallback:
About the Use of Facial Recognition Data

During calls, the front camera detects only your face position for speaker identification. No face data (images or biometrics) is stored. Detection stops immediately if you withdraw consent.
signup.termsCallLearningFallback:
About Call Conversation Learning

If you agree, your clone learns from your call conversations to provide more natural, personalized conversations. This consent is optional and can be withdrawn anytime in Settings. If you withdraw, only future call conversations are excluded from learning; content already learned is retained, not deleted. (Learned data is erased only when you delete your account or request full personal-data deletion.)
